benchmark.protocol: normalized generative scoring; abstention counts as miss

config.grading_rule: lowercase; punctuation/articles removed; whitespace collapsed; yes/no uses first normalized token; comma answers use normalized set equality

environment.python: 3.13.12 | packaged by Anaconda, Inc. | (main, Feb 24 2026, 16:05:56) [MSC v.1942 64 bit (AMD64)]

limitations: The evaluator and candidate remain in the same local repository.
The fresh subprocess has ambient filesystem and network access.
No external signature, nonce, or hidden test set is present.
The checksum is recomputable and does not authenticate the run.
Filesystem/network isolation and executed-code attestation are absent.
Public development data may have influenced candidate implementation.
